! Synthetic Cisco IOS XE-style switch configuration. No real credentials or addresses.
version 17.9
platform punt-keepalive disable-kernel-core
hostname SYNTHETIC-L2-SWITCH
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login MGMT local
username SYNTHETIC-L2-ADMIN secret 9 SYNTHETIC-L2-HASH
no ip http server
ip ssh version 2
ip access-list standard MGMT-VTY
 permit 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255
!
snmp-server community SYNTHETIC-L2-COMMUNITY RO MGMT-VTY
vlan 10
 name SYNTHETIC-CLIENTS
!
ip dhcp snooping
ip dhcp snooping vlan 10
ip arp inspection vlan 10
spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description SYNTHETIC-EDGE
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 switchport port-security
 switchport port-security maximum 2
 switchport port-security violation restrict
 no ip dhcp snooping trust
 no ip arp inspection trust
 spanning-tree portfast edge
 spanning-tree bpduguard enable
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/48
 description SYNTHETIC-UPLINK
 switchport mode trunk
 ip dhcp snooping trust
 ip arp inspection trust
!
line console 0
 login local
!
line vty 0 15

 access-class MGMT-VTY in
 login authentication MGMT
